column1: #   The KDOS defaults, key by key: testing/defaultscheck.py's fixture.
# One row a key, tab-separated: file, group, key, value, kind, why.
#   group   KConfig's own spelling of a nested group, a][b][c, so a group
#           whose name holds a slash (Event/startkde) stays one group
#   kind    kdos       the shipped config dirs give the key this value
#           immutable  the same, and no file above can change it ([$i])
#           kde        no shipped file sets the key, so KDE's compiled-in
#                      default (the value column) is what a person gets
#           vm         the value with /usr/share/kdos/xdg-vm in front, as a
#                      session in a virtual machine reads it
#           live       the value with /usr/share/kdos/xdg-live in front, as
#                      the live medium's session reads it
# The rows are the defaults desktop.md and applications.md describe, row for
# row: a change to a KDOS default is a change here and on those pages.
# Look and feel, light and dark, animation, click
